issues: One line of 100px mono text sat high-left on grey, two thirds of the frame empty, with no layout or hierarchy
The rewrite was only deletion; the 'no' beat had no image, so the three-act turn did not read
The copy 'just your command center' was awkward, and stem and claim were not separated
The indigo cursor and marker highlight clashed with the grey, and the ending was just a line of text
changes: Paper look (warm paper, ink, vermilion ribbon): a two-line 124px mono poster with the stem 'Kestrel is' in 400 secondary ink and the rewrite line in 700 primary ink, left-aligned at x=216 with a vermilion margin rule
Typewriter-impression type: each glyph gets a fixed per-index ±2px offset, ±0.6° tilt and 0.86–1 ink density, and lands with a 3f 1.06→1 strike

A visible 'no' beat: type 'a dashboard' at 2f/char, hold 20f while the cursor blinks twice, a vermilion strike-through draws in 6f, backspace at 1.5f/char (the strike shrinks with it), then retype at 1.5f/char without hesitation
The claim lands with a vermilion period, a 12px vermilion underline snapping under 'command center', and a 40px subline rising in
A slow 1→1.04 camera push throughout; 160→185f, and the last frame is a finished tagline poster
